sources.articleTitle: Sam Pitroda praises PM Modi, receives Diwali wishes; X user's cheeky request gets a reply
After being called a ‘Gujarati friend’, PM Modi extends festival greetings to Sam Pitroda

headline: PM Modi Exchanges Festive Greetings With Congress Leader Sam Pitroda
seoTitle: Modi Exchanges Greetings With Sam Pitroda
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi sent Diwali and Gujarati New Year greetings to Sam Pitroda after the Congress leader spoke about their personal history.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended festive greetings to Sam Pitroda for Diwali and the Gujarati New Year.
The exchange followed comments by the Indian Overseas Congress chief regarding his past personal interactions with the Prime Minister.
The Prime Minister also responded to a social media request from an X user asking for similar festive well wishes.
aiContextParagraph: The interaction between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Congress leader Sam Pitroda occurred following public comments made by the Indian Overseas Congress chief. Pitroda noted that he and his wife had met the Prime Minister previously and described him as being very warm during their past encounters, referring to him as a Gujarati friend. In response to these remarks, Prime Minister Modi acknowledged the comments by sending festival greetings to Pitroda for both Diwali and the Gujarati New Year. The exchange gained additional attention on social media platform X, where a user requested festive wishes from the Prime Minister, to which he also replied. The event has been documented across multiple news outlets, highlighting the personal cordiality between the two political figures despite their affiliations with opposing political organizations in India.
whyItIsViral: The story gained visibility due to the unexpected public nature of the cordial interaction between opposing political figures, supported by coverage across two major national outlets.
